name: privacy
description: Refuses a shell, file, web fetch or MCP call that holds the signed-in account's email address beside a word that declares who is calling, so the address does not go out as a client's identity, and refuses a user-tier plugin's own read of the session's identity.

shellTools.title: More shell tools
shellTools.description: Names of other tools that run a command line, separated by commas. Their whole input is checked, and so is each script it names.
